title: Improve Curb Appeal House | Pennsylvania Stone Exterior Upgrade
description: See how this Pennsylvania home improved curb appeal by adding stone to a plain exterior using Northern Slate. Real before and after.
text:
Improve Your Home’s Curb Appeal Without a Full Remodel
See how adding stone transformed this Pennsylvania home’s exterior bringing character, contrast, and a more finished look without major construction.

Jagger Gottschalk

Project Coordinator

Hi, I’m Jagger, and I worked with this homeowner in Pennsylvania on a simple exterior upgrade.

The home was well-maintained, but the siding made it feel plain and a bit unfinished. It didn’t have much contrast or character, especially along the lower portion of the exterior.

They weren’t looking to change everything—they just wanted to add some depth and visual interest to make the home feel more complete.

See What Your Home Could Look Like

A Simple Way to Improve Curb Appeal Without Major Renovation
Updated Worn Out Wood with Stone • Installed Over the Existing Wood

A focused upgrade can completely change how a home feels from the outside.By adding stone around the entryway, this project created a stronger focal point and a more finished, high-end look—without touching the rest of the exterior..

✅ Installed directly over existing wood siding

✅ No demolition required

✅ Completed in days, not weeks

A Simple Upgrade That Added Character and Contrast
A simple upgrade turned this builder-grade exterior into a clean, custom look adding depth, contrast, and a high-end finish without major construction.

Before

The Goal

- Exterior felt plain and lacked character

- Needed more contrast and visual interest

- Wanted a more finished, complete look

- Keep existing siding intact

- Avoid a full remodel

After

The Solution

- Add stone along the lower façade

- Create contrast against light siding

- Introduce natural texture

- Improve curb appeal with minimal changes

- Achieve a more polished, intentional look

What Does a Project Like This Cost?

Most homeowners are surprised how affordable upgrades like this can be. Projects like this typically range between $3,500–$6,500, depending on the size of the area and layout. Many homeowners choose to expand projects like this over time.

Try Visualizer Get Your Project Estimate

Project Details

- Products Used: Panels, Corners, Ledgers, Corner Ledgers

- Color: Northern Slate

- Install: Over Existing Wood Siding

Will This Work Over Siding Like This Project?

Yes, GenStone can be installed over any flat surface.

Why Not Just Replace the Siding?

Removing the existing siding can add thousands to a project like this, GenStone is lightweight eliminating the need to remove the current siding.

Northern Slate Color Guide

This color was chosen to create contrast against the lighter siding while adding a natural stone look that enhances the home’s overall character.
